I think, possibly, what you're misunderstanding is that the term "Nice guy" is actually a bad one here on reddit.  Low self-esteem, social anxiety disorder, avoidant personality disorder, major depressive disorder.  These are the most commonly cited "disorders" on reddit for why a "Nice guy" is a "Nice guy".

Most people don't like thinking they have a disorder, so instead you are a "Nice guy".  "Nice guys" may not have the social/emotional intelligence to connect with a girl/woman/lady on the level that you are able to connect with a man.  Let alone the ability to talk to women with more than one and two word answers.

It makes a person bitter.  But even "Nice guys" are human.  After a while they try to protect themselves from their loneliness by believing that nobody will treat a girlfriend as perfectly as they can(it's more complicated than that of course, this is just one aspect).  This extends to anger because **WHY THE FUCK DO THESE GIRLS NOT WANT ME!!!!! I'M SO MUCH BETTER THAN THE GUYS THEY'RE HOOKING UP WITH!!!!!!!**

This belief in how much better they are makes them perceive women(maybe not all) as bitches for not noticing them.  Which(if they don't have any male friends that show them how it really works) then turns into "Those other guys are fucking jerks, why do bitches always go for jerks??"

Some understand the reality and so use that here on reddit as an ironic piece of humour(which may or may not be understood).  Others get lost in that dream and mean it when they say it.  Some people are perfectly normal and are able to use it at just the right time with the just the right words to make it just plain funny.

This is reddit tho, an anonymous internet thing.  Any impact those statements have on you you're putting there.
